# Stable

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Damage and Healing](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Stable)*

A creature is Stable if it has 0 [Hit Points](../Stats/Hit-Points.md) but isn't required to make [Death Saving Throws](Death-Saving-Throw.md). *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[Damage and Healing](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#StabilizingaCharacter)").
